lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Traveller. The Choir remembered your ship. We have another delivery, if you are still willing to carry strange cargo.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: An egg. Warm. Precious. It must reach the golden world they call Fun Planet.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: We pay up front. Fuel and supplies. Enough that curiosity should feel unnecessary.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: What hatches is not your concern. Deliver it, and your concern ends.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Warm is how it likes to be. Keep it warm. Do not sing to it. It sings back.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Good. The handlers will load it now. Try not to tap the shell.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Then our debt remains settled. Travel safely.

options.line: Load it. I'll take it to Fun Planet.
Load it. I'll take it to Fun Planet.
